description: Allows the mob to move towards the nearest underwater ruin or shipwreck.

priority.description: As priority approaches 0, the priority is increased. The higher the priority, the sooner this behavior will be executed as a goal.

search_range.description: The range that the mob will search for a treasure chest within a ruin or shipwreck to move towards.

speed_multiplier.description: Movement speed multiplier of the mob when using this AI Goal

stop_distance.description: The distance the mob will move before stopping.
